We can still save them.|The Doctor Episode 1, "Predestination," ''[[Arknights: Prelude to Dawn]]''}} The '''Doctor''' is the player [[character]] in ''[[Arknights]]'' and serves as a central protagonist in the [[Main Theme]], playing a crucial role in the story alongside [[Amiya]]. {{Description|You can't remember anything.
At first, you can't feel anything. Things gradually start to feel familiar...
But in the end, you can't remember anything important.[[Archive]] description}} {{TOC limit|2}} ==Background== The Doctor of [[Rhodes Island]] remains enigmatic and elusive to most, but they are widely recognized as the organization’s chief strategist and field commander. Before joining Rhodes Island, the Doctor possessed extensive expertise in fields such as neurology, Originium research, and Catastrophe prediction—skills that have proven invaluable throughout Terra’s many crises.[[0-1/Story|0-1]][[Memoria]] Previously, the Doctor worked alongside [[Kal'tsit]] and [[Theresa]] as a core member of [[Babel]], a militant organization dedicated to improving the lives of the [[Sarkaz]]. Despite their strategic brilliance, the Doctor was known among Babel’s members for their empathy and resolve. [[Elite Op|Elite Operator]] [[Scout]] once remarked that even under immense pressure, the Doctor’s gaze remained fixed on victory, while [[Ines]] likened them to a chess player moving among wooden pieces.[[The Anonymous Ones' War]][[DM-5/Story|DM-5]] During this time, the Doctor also acted as a guardian to a young [[Amiya]], raising her with care and guidance. In the present, Amiya continues to regard them with deep affection and respect, seeing them as more than just a leader of Rhodes Island. Operators like [[Ace]], [[Scout]], and [[Logos]] have also recalled warm, casual conversations with the Doctor, revealing a humorous and approachable side.[[Valorem]] Following a catastrophic event that led to Babel’s collapse, the Doctor was placed into stasis within a [[Sarcophagus]] beneath [[Chernobog]], where they remained in suspended animation for three years.[[M8-8/Story#After operation|M8-8 After]] They were eventually awakened by Amiya at the outset of the [[Chernobog Crisis]], with no memory of their former life. This moment marked the beginning of Rhodes Island's current journey. Today, the Doctor leads Rhodes Island’s medical and paramilitary operations, coordinating field missions, studying Oripathy, and training Operators. Though physically frail and a non-combatant,[[Sideroca/File|Sideroca's Archive 4]], [[Nian/File]] their tactical genius makes them indispensable. While often seen masked and hooded outside the landship, some Operators reference seeing their face directly, suggesting they unmask in private. [[File:PtD-Doctor's Eye.png|thumb|A glimpse of the Doctor's eyes]] In the anime ''[[Arknights: Prelude to Dawn]]'', the Doctor is depicted with snow-white hair, dark gray eyes, and an androgynous voice. Though lacking physical strength, their intelligence and empathy have earned the respect of countless Rhodes Island members. According to [[Warfarin]], the Doctor's blood has unusual properties, and [[Kal'tsit]] has used it in emergency medical treatments on Amiya.[[END8-1]] Beyond battlefield strategy, the Doctor also handles internal affairs—building diplomatic and commercial ties with influential figures across Terra, including the ruling bodies of [[Kazimierz]], the secretive [[Maylander Foundation]] in [[Columbia]], and [[SilverAsh|Enciodes Silverash]] of [[Kjerag]]. In their spare time, the Doctor mentors young Operators like [[Ifrit]] and [[Projekt Red]], maintaining a guiding presence as an educator despite their amnesia. {{Spoiler start|cn=false|Main Theme,Babel (event){{!}}the Babel event}} As the story of ''Arknights'' progresses, the Doctor is revealed to be the only known living [[Predecessor]], a spacefaring humanoid race that arrived on [[Terra]] over 13,000 years ago. In their time, the Doctor was mainly known as '''Oracle''', a codename from their research group.[[BB-ST-3]] As an accomplished scientist, they were central to multiple pivotal events in the far distant past. Together with their partner [[Priestess]], the Doctor was involved in the creation of [[Originium]] as a means to ensure their civilization’s survival in the face of an existential threat from the [[Observer]]s. They also played a part in the creation of AMa-10—later known as [[Kal'tsit]]—and contributed significantly to the fields of neurology and military tactics. [[File:Doctor and Priestess.png|left|thumb|The enigmatic Doctor of Rhodes Island is more than just a researcher and commander]] The Doctor boasts an extraordinary intellectual capability before and after their amnesia: in the past, they created an algorithm capable of precisely predicting [[Catastrophe]] movements[[Memoria]], and were a leading mind in [[Oripathy]] research. However, these contributions are only one part of a much darker legacy. During their time in the organization [[Babel]], the Doctor served as a field commander, Oripathy researcher, and advisor to [[Theresa]] alongside Kal'tsit, working toward uplifting the [[Sarkaz]] and ending their systemic oppression. Despite showing great empathy—such as granting mercy to a confused attacker and supporting a loyal soldier who had erred[[Cogitatio]][[Anterior]]—the tormented Doctor, wracked with grief, ultimately made a devastating decision to continue what they call the Originium Project—the necessary assimilation of Terra for the sake of all life.[[BB-9/Story]] In a secret arrangement with [[Theresis]], the Doctor facilitated the assassination of Theresa, effectively initiating Babel's collapse. They disabled the landship’s defenses at a time when most of Babel's fighting force was away, allowing fanatical [[Deathveil Assassin|assassins]] to strike. However, the Doctor came face to face with the dying Theresa out of concern for Amiya. In Theresa's final moments, she used the last of her strength to erase the Doctor’s memories, with the intent of giving them a chance to live a new life.[[BB-10/Story]] Following Babel’s fall, Kal'tsit placed the comatose Doctor in the [[Sarcophagus]] deep within [[Chernobog]], where they remained for three years to recover from their physical and mental injuries. Upon their awakening at the start of the Main Theme, the Doctor had no recollection of their past decisions or identity. Some characters, such as Kal'tsit and [[W]], still harbor deep resentment toward the Doctor for their role in Theresa's death and some elite operators such as [[Pith]] opposed the decision to rescue the Doctor.[[Elite Operator: Departure]] Nonetheless, honoring Theresa’s final wish, Kal'tsit continues to protect the Doctor and [[Amiya]]. {{Spoiler end|Main Theme,the Babel event}} ==Gallery== ===Miscellaneous=== Doctor Limbus Company Sprite.png|The Doctor as an NPC in [https://limbuscompany.wiki.gg/wiki/Episode_Arknights_-_EX:_Pilgrimage_of_Compassion ''Limbus Company''] Doctor Anime Render.png|The Doctor's official render from ''[[Arknights: Prelude to Dawn]]'' RFE-Evil Spirit of Babel.png|The Doctor's Babel uniform, as seen in Episode 2 of ''[[Arknights: Rise from Ember]]'' ===Concept Art=== Doctor's Concept Art.png|The Doctor's concept art from the anime, as seen in ''[[Arknights Official Artworks|Arknights Official Artworks RESET Vol. 1]]'' PTD-Doctor Concept Art.png|The Doctor's concept and key arts from ''Arknights Animation Artworks Vol.1'' ===Other media=== PTD-Doctor Character Visual.png|The Doctor's character visual from ''Arknights: Prelude to Dawn'' ==Notes== {{Notelist}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Features}}
